element.note: constructed illustration: an instrument scoring f on every supported class; the sign flips between conventions iff the supported-class counts differ

conventions.universe: outer join over every manifest paragraph; gold off-topic = empty gold set
conventions.weights: design weights 1/pi per paragraph on every count; unweighted beside it
conventions.macro: point estimate over classes with positive gold support in the population; resampled statistic = available-class macro-F1
conventions.reportability: per-class cell printed when support_rows >= 5; suppression does not change aggregates or macro membership
conventions.undefined: TP+FP+FN = 0 or an empty denominator stays undefined
conventions.stability: conditional on successful executions; empty technology union has no relation-level score
conventions.displacement: design-weighted, reference-relative, for the eligible frame; no bias-correction estimator; failed execution 1 counts as absence

reliability.route: intra-coder temporal stability (5-day interval; applied minimum 4, registered 14; deviation disclosed)

inputs.washout_deviation: author's decision of 2026-10-12 to begin the re-code at once, to recover schedule; coded 2026-10-13, five days after the last first-coding date (2026-10-08); registered 14 days, applied minimum 4; agent advised against; disclosed in the specification, labels README, usage log, GUIDE-LLM and Chapter 5
